title: Resume renewal after collection authority restart or rollback
preconditions: a protected session has accepted temporal continuity state
steps: restart or roll back the collection authority or its protected monotonic source
bind a fresh challenge under changed or reused epoch state
request same-session renewal with the old session key and handle
invariants: authority restart rollback epoch change or protected-source discontinuity terminates the current protected session
recovery requires a new session key handle challenge and scoped epoch
residual_risk: safe durable authority migration requires a separately approved mechanism
